description: A bearded, shirtless man in a fur or leather skirt leans over a stone mould, tipping a glowing clay crucible of molten orange metal so a stream pours into a stone block with sparks flying. Behind him on the left is a domed clay furnace glowing with fire. Round copper-coloured discs with green patina and silver-grey ingots sit on the ground, with charcoal, tongs and hammers scattered around. A second figure with a glowing object stands in the dim background. The scene is dark and painterly, with no visible text or frame.
